"[project]/lib/format.js [app-ssr] (ecmascript)", ((__turbopack_context__) => {
"use strict";

// Formatting helpers shared by server and client components.
__turbopack_context__.s([
    "STATUS_LABEL",
    ()=>STATUS_LABEL,
    "fmtDate",
    ()=>fmtDate,
    "fmtDateTime",
    ()=>fmtDateTime,
    "fmtInt",
    ()=>fmtInt,
    "fmtNum",
    ()=>fmtNum,
    "fmtSAR",
    ()=>fmtSAR,
    "isoDay",
    ()=>isoDay
]);
const fmtInt = (n)=>n === null || n === undefined ? '—' : Math.round(Number(n)).toLocaleString('en-US');
const fmtNum = (n, d = 1)=>n === null || n === undefined ? '—' : Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        minimumFractionDigits: d,
        maximumFractionDigits: d
    });
const fmtSAR = (n)=>n === null || n === undefined ? '—' : Number(n).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        minimumFractionDigits: 2,
        maximumFractionDigits: 2
    }) + ' SAR';
// Dates from PostgreSQL arrive as JS Date (midnight UTC) or ISO strings - always format in UTC
function toDate(v) {
    if (!v) return null;
    const d = v instanceof Date ? v : new Date(String(v).length === 10 ? v + 'T00:00:00Z' : v);
    return Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) ? null : d;
}
function fmtDate(v) {
    const d = toDate(v);
    return d ? d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short',
        year: 'numeric',
        timeZone: 'UTC'
    }) : '—';
}
function fmtDateTime(v) {
    const d = toDate(v);
    return d ? d.toLocaleString('en-GB', {
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short',
        year: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        timeZone: 'UTC'
    }) : '—';
}
function isoDay(v) {
    const d = toDate(v);
    return d ? d.toISOString().slice(0, 10) : null;
}
const STATUS_LABEL = {
    stockout: 'Stockout',
    below_rop: 'Below ROP',
    at_risk: 'At risk',
    insufficient_history: 'Insufficient history',
    ok: 'Healthy'
};
}),
];
